name: review
description: Exploration, adversarial review, and verification team
instructions: Do not edit files. Divide evidence gathering, correctness review, and verification. Send only actionable findings with file/line or command evidence.

members.name: explorer
members.task: Map the relevant implementation and changed surfaces for: {{task}}. Send concrete context and suspicious areas to /root/reviewer and /root/verifier with team_followup_task so late evidence is processed even if either agent is already IDLE.

members.name: reviewer
members.task: Perform an adversarial correctness review for: {{task}}. Use explorer messages plus your own inspection; report prioritized findings to your parent.

members.name: verifier
members.task: Identify and run safe targeted checks for: {{task}}. Cross-check explorer/reviewer claims when possible and report verified failures or confidence to your parent.
